title: Data Type Declaration
prompt:
Declare and initialize variables of different data types (integer, float, string, boolean) and print their values. The program should take no input and output the values of the variables.
Sample Output: Integer: 10
Float: 3.14
String: Hello World
Boolean: True
answer:
Sure, I'd be happy to help you with that! Here's a Python program that meets your requirements:

```python
# Declare and initialize variables of different data types

# Integer
integer_var = 10
print("Integer:", integer_var)

# Float
float_var = 3.14
print("Float:", float_var)

# String
string_var = "Hello World"
print("String:", string_var)

# Boolean
boolean_var = True
print("Boolean:", boolean_var)
```

When you run this program, it will output:

```
Integer: 10
Float: 3.14
String: Hello World
Boolean: True
```
